column1: # Deterministic rule checks, run by ~/.claude/scripts/rule-check.sh on ADDED lines only (old code never fails).
# One rule per line, TAB-separated: id  severity(error|warn)  scope  match  unless  message
# scope: main = src/main/**.java, test = src/test/**, java = *.java, config = *.yml|*.yaml|*.properties, code = java+config
# match/unless: POSIX ERE (no \b or \s; use [[:space:]] and (^|[^A-Za-z])). unless '-' = none.
# error fails G2; warn is listed for the gate to judge. To automate a repeated review finding, add a line here.

column6: Constructor injection with final fields; no @Autowired (es-code: Code rules).
Debug output in main code: use the repo logger.
Inject Clock for anything time-based; no now() without a clock.
Delete temp files in finally; no deleteOnExit() in a long-running service.
Empty catch: handle, rethrow or classify the failure.
Untracked TODO: use '// shortcut: <risk>, <when to upgrade>' plus a plan.md Follow-ups row.
Plain-text secret in config: use the repo's secret source.
Ticket refs belong in <work> files, not code comments.
Process notes belong in <work> files, not code comments.
Looks like commented-out code: delete it.
Parameterized tests use @CsvSource with | as the delimiter.
